legal.providerText: Quizzler is operated by Tim Fischer as a private provider.
legal.contentText: The content of this private website is prepared with care. If you notice an error or believe that content infringes your rights, please contact me using the email address above. Statutory responsibility for the content remains unaffected.
legal.linksText: External websites are operated by their respective providers. If you notice unlawful content on a linked website, please let me know so that I can review the link.
legal.copyrightText: Content created by the operator is subject to applicable copyright law. Third-party rights remain with their respective owners. Uses beyond those permitted by law require the rights holder's permission.
privacy.intro: This policy explains how personal data is processed when you use this privately operated Quizzler website.
privacy.controllerText: Tim Fischer is the controller responsible for personal data on this website and operates it as a private provider. For privacy questions or requests, please use the contact details below.
privacy.hostingText: The website is intended for hosting on Cloudflare Pages, provided by Cloudflare, Inc., 101 Townsend St, San Francisco, CA 94107, USA. When the website is delivered through Cloudflare, Cloudflare processes technical request data, which may include your IP address, requested URL, date and time, browser information and security events, to deliver and protect the website. The legal basis is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR: the legitimate interest in a reliable, secure website.
privacy.transferText: Cloudflare may process data outside the EU/EEA, including in the USA. Applicable safeguards depend on the service and agreement, and may include an applicable adequacy decision or EU standard contractual clauses. The provider's privacy and data-processing information describes these safeguards. Retention of technical data depends on the enabled Cloudflare services and their settings; no fixed retention period is specified here.
privacy.storageText: The site saves your selected language (en or de) in your browser's local storage under quizzler-language, including the default English selection on first use. This keeps the language consistent across pages and later visits. The preference is read by this website's script and is not sent to the operator as part of a separate tracking request. It remains until you clear the website's browser data or change the selection. The purpose is to provide your preferred interface language; the legal basis for any associated personal-data processing is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR.
privacy.trackingText: The current website code contains no analytics, advertising trackers, account registration or contact forms and does not set application cookies. Cloudflare may use cookies or similar technologies for security depending on the services enabled.
privacy.emailText: If you email me, your address, message and any details you provide are processed to respond to your enquiry. Please only send information needed for your request. The legal basis is Article 6(1)(f) GDPR, based on the interest in answering enquiries; Article 6(1)(b) GDPR applies where an enquiry concerns a contract. Messages are deleted when the enquiry is resolved and the data is no longer needed, unless a legal retention obligation or the defence of legal claims requires further storage. Email service providers may process the correspondence as part of delivering and storing email.
privacy.rightsText: Subject to the applicable legal conditions, you have rights to access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing and data portability. You may object to processing based on legitimate interests for reasons relating to your particular situation. If processing relies on consent, you may withdraw that consent for the future. Contact me to exercise these rights. No automated decision-making or profiling is carried out by this website's code.
privacy.complaintText: You may also lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority, including the authority in your place of residence, work or the alleged infringement. In Rhineland-Palatinate, you can contact the State Commissioner for Data Protection and Freedom of Information.
privacy.updatesText: This policy will be updated when the site's functions or data processing change.
